dialogue.origin: こんにちは相談員です　よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: 今日のお花をお聞かせください
dialogue.content: Could you share what you'd like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どんなご相談でしょうか
dialogue.content: What would you like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 職場のことで悩んでいます。
dialogue.content: I'm struggling with something at work.

dialogue.origin: ご相談ありがとうございます。どんなご相談ですか。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that. Could you tell me more about it?

dialogue.origin: 職場での人間関係？についてです…
dialogue.content: It's about... relationships at work, I think...

dialogue.origin: その前に、年齢と性別をお教えください
dialogue.content: Before we proceed, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 23歳、女性です。
dialogue.content: I'm a 23-year-old woman.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます早速、具体的にことですか
dialogue.content: Thank you. To begin, could you tell me specifically what the issue is?

dialogue.origin: どのようなことですか
dialogue.content: What is happening?

dialogue.origin: 先輩？上司？の言い方がキツく感じます。周りの目も気になってしまうので…働きにくいです。
dialogue.content: The way my senior—or maybe my supervisor—speaks feels harsh. I also worry about what others think, so it makes it difficult to work.

dialogue.origin: 職場に行きたくないとも思います。
dialogue.content: Sometimes I even feel like I don't want to go to work.

dialogue.origin: ええ、毎日のことではつらいですね。どのような場面で言われるのですか
dialogue.content: Yes, that must be difficult to deal with every day. In what kind of situations does this happen?

dialogue.origin: 場所、状況構わず言われます。主に一対一の場面などですね…
dialogue.content: It happens regardless of the place or situation. It's mainly when we're one-on-one...

dialogue.origin: これと言った場面はないです…ただ、毎日でもないんです…
dialogue.content: There isn't one specific situation... but it also doesn't happen every day...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね1対1ではきついですね。どんな内容ですか。
dialogue.content: I see. It must be tough when it's one-on-one. What kind of things do they say?

dialogue.origin: 「何でこれ共有してくれなかったの？」や「これで良くない？」と威圧的に言われます。他にも、自分が言ってきたことを否定もされます。
dialogue.content: They'll say things in an intimidating tone, like 'Why didn’t you share this?' or 'Isn’t this good enough?' They also dismiss things that I say.

dialogue.origin: 共有しなかったのではなく、できなかったり、その必要性が明らかになかったので、しなかっただけなのですが…
dialogue.content: It's not that I didn't share it; it's that I either couldn't or there was clearly no need to, so I just didn't...

dialogue.origin: ええ、威圧的では、質問やご自分の思ったことや考えを伝えにくいですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, when someone is intimidating, it's difficult to ask questions or express your own thoughts and ideas, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、言葉に詰まりますよね。あなたは、そのあと、どのようにしているのでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I can imagine. It must leave you at a loss for words. What do you usually do afterward?

dialogue.origin: まず我慢します。その後、整理しますがやっぱりおかしいと思うと、もらった意見を尊重しながらも動いたりしてみますが、、ずっとモヤモヤしています…
dialogue.content: First, I endure it. Then, I try to process it, and if I still feel something is wrong, I try to act while respecting the feedback I received... but I'm always left with this lingering, unsettled feeling.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、ご自分なりに取り組んでみるかと思いますが、気持ちはすっきりしませんよね。そんなとき、同じ部署の方にお話をすることはありますか。
dialogue.content: I understand. You try to handle it in your own way, but it doesn't resolve the feeling, does it? At times like that, do you ever talk to anyone in the same department?

dialogue.origin: 同じ部署の人にはあまり話しません…
dialogue.content: I don't really talk to people in my department about it...

dialogue.origin: 我慢できないと話しますが…
dialogue.content: I do if I can't stand it anymore, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ、言いづらいですよね。そのあとのモヤモヤした気持ちはどうのようにしていますか。
dialogue.content: Yes, it must be hard to bring up. What do you do with that unsettled feeling afterward?

dialogue.origin: 他部署の先輩か、母、友人に話しますかね…でも、それではスッキリせず、モヤモヤしたまま過ごしてます…
dialogue.content: I might talk to a senior from another department, or my mother, or a friend... but it doesn't really resolve anything, and I just carry that unsettled feeling with me...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、話ができる方はいらっしゃるですね。話してモヤモヤしたままなんですね。気持ちが重たくなりますね。
dialogue.content: I see, so you do have people you can talk to. But you're still left with that unsettled feeling after talking. That must weigh heavily on you.

dialogue.origin: はい…結局我慢かなぁと思ってしまいます。
dialogue.content: Yes... In the end, I end up thinking I just have to endure it.

dialogue.origin: やっぱり年上の方ばかりなので何も言い返せないですね…態度に出すのも違うし…
dialogue.content: After all, they're all older than me, so I can't say anything back... and showing it in my attitude doesn't feel right either...

dialogue.origin: ええ、そんな気持ちになるんですね。年上の方には言いづらいし、態度に出すとどう思われるか気になりますね。
dialogue.content: I can see why you'd feel that way. It’s hard to speak up to older colleagues, and you worry how they might perceive you if it showed in your attitude.

dialogue.origin: そうですね…また、勝手に思っているだけかもしれませんが、傷つきやすい人が多いんです…負の連鎖になって欲しくないので「我慢」を選択してしまいます💦
dialogue.content: That's right... Also, and maybe this is just my impression, but a lot of the people there are quite sensitive... I don't want to start a negative chain reaction, so I end up choosing to 'endure' it.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ご自分が我慢すれば済むことかと思ってしまいますね。
dialogue.content: Yes, you end up feeling that if you just endure it yourself, the problem will go away.

dialogue.origin: はい…下っ端だし仕方ないかなぁと思ってます…
dialogue.content: Yes... Since I'm the most junior person there, I feel like it can't be helped.

dialogue.origin: ええ、それが続いてくると仕事にも行きたくなくなりますね。仕事の内容はどう思っていますか。
dialogue.content: Yes, when that continues, it can make you not want to go to work. How do you feel about the work itself?

dialogue.origin: 仕事は…内容によりますが楽しいです本当に内容や周囲の状況になりますがやりがいも感じています
dialogue.content: The work itself... it depends on the task, but I enjoy it. It really depends on the content and the circumstances, but I do find it rewarding.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです、やりがいを感じているんですね。
dialogue.content: I see, so you do find it rewarding.

dialogue.origin: はい…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time today.

topic.sub: 職場の人間関係の悩み
